answer_1.quote: Our work specifically examines interactive conversational scenarios where the user and the system engage in dynamic dialogue. ... We propose response quality evaluation to evaluate both function-calling and non-function calling responses via dialog act classification, categorizing responses as seeking information, providing information, rejecting requests or calling functions.
answer_1.outputs: function calls and textual agent responses

answer_2.quote: We leverage abstract syntax trees (AST) to evaluate function-calling turns ... We use AlignScore to calculate the matching accuracy for string parameter values. ... We also perform an analysis on how often the models hallucinate parameters at the action calls. ... We use an off-the-shelf LLM to do hallucination detection.

answer_3.quote: We use an off-the-shelf LLM to do hallucination detection. ... We use gpt-4o-mini as an LLM judge to avoid bias in the evaluation. ... we use an LLM-based dialog act classifier that is prompted to generate one or more of the dialog acts for an agent response.
